question: To what kind of person is something claimed to be given, according to the qualifications stated?
premises: Something is marked as to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: What is to be given is claimed to go to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: The thing to be given is not specified here.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
